title: Shibhi Studio: refine vinyl/HDD alignment and animation behaviors

requirements.summary: Adjust VinylPlayer placement so the vinyl sits closer to the “shibhi.studio” wordmark and aligns visually across breakpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: On desktop (lg+), the vinyl record appears visually closer to the “shibhi.studio” wordmark than before (reduced gap), without overlapping the text.
The vinyl record is vertically aligned so its centerline feels horizontally aligned with the “shibhi.studio” wordline (no noticeable vertical misalignment).
No layout regressions on mobile: header text and vinyl remain readable and do not overflow the viewport.

file_operations.description: Tune the header row layout (gap/justify/margins) to reduce the space between the wordmark block and the VinylPlayer at lg+ while preserving a safe non-overlapping layout on smaller breakpoints.

Adjust VinylPlayer’s outer wrapper sizing/alignment (container flex alignment and/or responsive sizing) to better match the wordmark’s horizontal axis across breakpoints without changing playback behavior.

requirements.summary: Mirror the HDD tonearm rotation so the sweep appears on the right side of the platter while preserving category-to-angle behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: When hovering categories (or selecting a category), the tonearm rotates in the mirrored direction such that the visual sweep appears on the platter’s right side.
The arm’s rotation origin remains visually correct (no drifting/offset pivot).
Arm shadow (if present) remains aligned with the mirrored arm position/rotation.

file_operations.description: Mirror the HDD arm and its shadow by adjusting the arm transform math and/or applying a horizontal mirror transform to the arm/shadow layers while keeping the same category-to-angle mapping and a stable transformOrigin pivot.
If needed after mirroring, adjust the HDD arm shadow styling to remain visually aligned with the mirrored arm position and rotation (no offset/drift).

requirements.summary: Increase HDD platter baseline spin speed to ~3× and add smooth hover/active acceleration (ease-in) and deceleration back to baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: The platter’s baseline spin speed is increased to ~3× the prior rate (relative visual comparison).
When the HDD becomes hovered/active, the spin rate ramps up smoothly (ease-in) instead of changing abruptly.
When not hovered/active, the platter returns smoothly to its baseline (no jarring snap).

file_operations.description: Replace the platter’s class-toggled CSS animation approach with a JS-driven rotation (e.g., Web Animations API or rAF) that supports a baseline speed (~3× prior) and smoothly interpolates to a faster speed on hovered/active, then eases back when inactive.
Update/repurpose the existing disk spin animation utilities as needed to align with the new baseline speed and to ensure no leftover class-based animation causes abrupt speed changes.

requirements.summary: Reduce the default opacity of the VinylPlayer play/pause toggle while keeping accessible hover/focus-visible affordances and no behavior changes.
acceptanceCriteria: The play/pause button appears slightly more translucent than before in its default state.
Hover/focus-visible states still clearly indicate interactivity and remain readable against the vinyl/background.
Button continues to toggle playback correctly (no functional changes).

file_operations.description: Adjust the VinylPlayer toggle Button styling to be slightly more translucent by default, while keeping strong hover/focus-visible styles and leaving toggle logic unchanged. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Boost ElectronHoverLink glow and render visibly moving particles only while a target category is hovered (ElectronHoverLink active).
acceptanceCriteria: When a category is hovered and the electron link appears, the line is noticeably brighter/more “glowy” than before.
Particles visibly travel along the line while the link is active.
When no category is hovered (ElectronHoverLink inactive), particles/line are not rendered (or are fully absent as currently).

file_operations.description: Increase line glow intensity (e.g., brighter stroke plus shadowBlur/multi-pass glow) and make particle motion more apparent (e.g., slightly higher count/speed/contrast), while ensuring nothing is rendered when origin/target are null (inactive state).
Ensure ElectronHoverLink activation remains strictly tied to hovered category targeting (no link/particles when not hovering), keeping the existing wiring from HDD anchor to hovered category element.

requirements.summary: Ensure the project can be clean-built and redeployed using the existing runbook/scripts after the UI/animation changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend builds successfully with no TypeScript errors.
The updated UI/animations are visible in the deployed app.

file_operations.description: Update the redeploy runbook to explicitly reference using the existing scripts for a clean rebuild/redeploy after UI/animation updates, and add a brief verification checklist aligned with the updated vinyl/HDD behaviors.
If necessary, adjust script messaging/log output to emphasize clean build verification for the updated UI/animation changes (no behavior change to the script’s steps).
